_Updated 2026-10-10 01:08 UTC by `factory/readme.py` from the ledger branch and the Alpaca paper account._

### Current strategy: `residual_lowcorr_reversal`
- 1Day bars, promoted 2026-10-07, source [strategies/candidates/residual_lowcorr_reversal.py](https://github.com/jadefjestad/trader-dark-factory/blob/main/strategies/candidates/residual_lowcorr_reversal.py).
- Method: Hypothesis: residual_reversal (PR #136) had the highest holdout Sharpe of any candidate (about 1.9) but a weak validation (0.71); it buys recent stock-specific losers, which the champion's residual-momentum and low-correlation sleeves never hold. Adding it as a third equal sleeve to the champion residual_lowcorr_blend (PR #132) should diversify the book and raise the holdout without losing much validation. Reversal rebalances weekly, the other sleeves monthly; turnover stays near a third of the reversal sleeve's 22x a year.
